- Either (a) a corrected November invoice showing the true-up or (b) a separate proforma/true-up invoice we can pay immediately. We prefer a single invoice for our AP team, but can accept a short proforma if that is easier.

PO reference: HT-PO-2219 (will be used for reconciliation).

Attaching our provisioning export for your reconciliation.

Thanks — Samir

Evelyn / Samir — ran the numbers and attached a proposed adjusted invoice + a proforma for the true-up. Summary below: 

Calculation notes (Nov cycle = 30 days):
- Seat unit price (list): $200.00 / seat / month
- Seats increased: 15 (from 42 -> 57) on 2026-11-04 (day 4 counted as chargeable)
- Chargeable days for new seats: 27 days (Nov 4–30 inclusive)
- Prorated multiplier: 27 / 30 = 0.9
- Gross true-up (USD): 15 seats * $200 * 0.9 = $2,700.00

Tax handling (based on VAT FR987654321 validation pending):
- If VIES validates and we confirm B2B status: apply reverse-charge (no Redwood VAT on proforma).
- If not validated: apply Redwood standard VAT at 20% (France rate) and reissue if customer provides valid VAT evidence afterward.

Options we can issue today: 
A) Immediate proforma for the true-up (Invoice: PROFORMA-HT-20261119) for $2,700.00 (VAT treatment TBD). Customer pays proforma; we post payment against Nov invoice.
B) Issue corrected November invoice (INVOICE-202611) that includes the pro-rated line and the usual subscription lines — this keeps AP with a single accounting document. If you prefer this, we will void the existing Nov invoice and replace it (can take ~24h).

Attached: redwood_adjusted_invoice_20261119.pdf (proposed corrected invoice preview), proforma_trueup_harmony_20261119.pdf

Please confirm preferred path and whether you can upload the VAT doc to the portal now. Also confirm whether HarmonyTech prefers net-30 payment terms on the proforma.

— Rishi
